bio.text: Stephen Chan is a Republican member of the New York State Senate representing Brooklyn's 17th District, which he won in November 2024 by defeating Democratic incumbent Iwen Chu.

The Brooklyn Paper describes him as a retired U.S. Marine and former New York City Police Department sergeant who immigrated to Bay Ridge from Hong Kong with his family at age 11 and has lived in Bensonhurst since 1992.

sources.title: Stephen Chan celebrates historic win at State Senate swearing-in ceremony
